key_findings: Rabies tracing identified 45 input nuclei to PIC GABAergic neurons, densest from Pir and S2 of the isocortex and thalamic PO and PAF, with ipsilateral preference.
Anterograde tracing revealed 18 output targets of PIC GABAergic neurons, densest in CPu, GPe and VP of the basal ganglia and amygdala subnuclei.
The thalamus provides dense inputs to PIC GABAergic neurons but receives no outputs; the isocortex is input-dominant while basal ganglia and amygdala are output-dominant.
PIC GABAergic neurons include long-range projection neurons, contrary to an earlier report of no long-range projections.
